title: close of a clone's own sprint can rewrite an upstream item's relates_to or depends_on link to a deleted item
goal: backlog.py close, when it drops a deleted item's id from the links of remaining items, leaves every item that arrived from the clone's upstream main unchanged, as every other writer does since BG-wojfmyzp

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e)
        sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import json, os, subprocess as S, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import backlog
T = Path(backlog.__file__).resolve().parent
t = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
e = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
g = lambda *a, cwd: S.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=e)
b = lambda r, *a: (lambda p: (p.returncode, p.stdout + p.stderr))(S.run([sys.executable, str(T / "backlog.py"), "--root", str(r), *a], cwd=r, capture_output=True, text=True, env=e))
u = t / "up"
u.mkdir()
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main", cwd=u)
(u / "backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir": "items", "id_prefixes": {"story": "ST", "bug": "BG", "sprint": "SP"}}))
up = b(u, "new", "story", "--title", "upstream item", "--touch", "x", "--goal", "g")[1].split()[2]
f = u / "items" / (up + ".json")
d = json.loads(f.read_text())
d["relates_to"], d["depends_on"] = ["ST-aaaaaaaa"], ["ST-aaaaaaaa"]
f.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=2) + "\n")
g("add", "-A", cwd=u)
g("commit", "-qm", "p", cwd=u)
c = t / "clone"
g("clone", "-q", "-o", "upstream", str(u), str(c), cwd=t)
g("config", "kb.upstreamRemote", "upstream", cwd=c)
sp = b(c, "new", "sprint", "--title", "own sprint", "--goal", "g")[1].split()[2]
own = {"id": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "story", "title": "own item", "status": "done", "sprint": sp, "priority": "P3", "rank": 0, "goal": "g", "touches": ["x"]}
(c / "items" / "ST-aaaaaaaa.json").write_text(json.dumps(own, indent=2) + "\n")
before = (c / "items" / (up + ".json")).read_bytes()
# the story and sprint review items of the own sprint are done as well
for p in (c / "items").glob("*.json"):
    j = json.loads(p.read_text())
    if j.get("sprint") == sp and j["id"] != sp and j.get("status") != "done":
        j["status"] = "done"
        p.write_text(json.dumps(j, indent=2) + "\n")
rc, out = b(c, "close", sp)
after = (c / "items" / (up + ".json")).read_bytes()
assert "closed" in out, ("close did not run to its end", rc, out[-400:])
assert after == before, ("close rewrote the link of an item that arrived from the upstream main", json.loads(after).get("relates_to"), json.loads(after).get("depends_on"))
